Estimate a Vaccination Coverage and Timeliness Chart

Source: R/vctc.R
estimate_vctc.Rd

Computes everything a VCTC displays: crude coverage of every dose with a confidence interval, sample size, effective sample size, design effect and ICC; the weighted share of each timing category; the proportion of children who showed a home-based record; and the fully-vaccinated and not-vaccinated proportions for the footnote.

estimate_vctc(
  x,
  design = NULL,
  vaccines = NULL,
  evidence = "card_or_recall",
  subset = NULL,
  fully_vaccinated = NULL,
  rules = vcs_timing_rules(),
  age_eligible = TRUE,
  ci_method = "wilson",
  level = 0.95,
  design_args = list()
)

Arguments

x

A vcs_data object.

design

Optional vcs_design() whose specification (clusters, strata, weights) is reused. Otherwise design_args are passed to vcs_design().

vaccines

Doses to chart; defaults to the schedule order.

evidence

Definition of "received"; see vcs_evidence_definitions().

subset

An optional logical expression on the child-level table selecting one domain, e.g. health_zone == "Boma".

fully_vaccinated

Doses that define "fully vaccinated" for the footnote. Defaults to schedule_final_doses().

rules

A vcs_timing_rules().

age_eligible

Restrict each dose's denominator to children whose age at interview is at least the dose's minimum age.

ci_method

"wilson" (default here, as in VCQI) or "normal".

level

Confidence level.

design_args

Passed to vcs_design() when design is NULL.

Value

An object of class vcs_vctc: a list with coverage (one row per dose), timing (long, one row per dose and category), card_seen, fully, not_vaccinated, n_children, schedule, evidence and domain.

Details

Crude coverage uses every child in the denominator (a child with no evidence counts as not vaccinated), which is the convention of published coverage tables and of VCQI's RI_COVG_01. Doses due after the youngest age in the survey window are estimated among age-eligible children only when age_eligible = TRUE.

See also

plot_vctc(), derive_dose_timing()

Examples

v <- estimate_vctc(vcs_example)
v$coverage[, c("vaccine", "estimate", "conf_low", "conf_high", "deff")]
